references.text: The Lord tells David that He will raise up a descendant after him and establish his kingdom.
God confirms through Solomon that He will fulfill His promise to David of a descendant who will sit on his throne.
The prophecy about a son who will be born, who will have the government on his shoulders, and whose kingdom will be eternal.
The genealogy of Jesus, showing his descent from David.
Jesus is described as a descendant of David, for whom God has prepared a throne.
